text.p: ImmuDyne Inc said Tuesday that a $4.5 million order from Tepual SA has been canceled.

In a statement, ImmuDyne said that although both companies regret that the original purchase order was not completed, there is agreement that there are opportunities for both companies to work together through distribution of ImmuStim Immersion Concentrate and additional products.

Immudyne said Tepual said it is continuing its product testing to find the best combinations of feed utilizing ImmuStim in shrimp and other animal species with the intention of marketing these products as they are proven.

Immudyne said Tepual will begin distribution of ImmuDyne's ImmuStim Immersion Concentrate for the aquaculture industry in its international markets in September 1997 and is investigating opportunities in the ornamental fish market as well.
